Number		 Violations cited in this report must be corrected within the time frames below.
14 Violation of Code: [46.731] The can opener had an accumulation of food residue on the food contact surfaces.
* Can opener was removed and properly cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site.
14 Violation of Code: [46.731] The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay ware wash sink was 500 ppm, rather than 100-400 ppm as stated on the manufacturer's use directions.
*Sanitizer was drained and refilled and observed at 100 ppm. Corrected On-Site.
45 Violation of Code: [46.671] Handle observed loose on cold prep unit in salad prep area. New Violation.
47 Violation of Code: [46.714] - Food debris observed on floor surface of walk-in cooler.
- Dust accumulation observed on fan vent covers in walk-in cooler.
-Dust accumulation observed on wall vent in alcohol storage closet. New Violation.
53 Violation of Code: [46.921] - Food debris observed on flooring surface under refrigeration equipment in kitchen area.
- Debris and dust observed under storage racks. New Violation.

You are required under Section 6-502 of the Philadelphia Health Code to correct the violations listed as noted above.
